verdict.rationale: Retell documents an official MCP server that lets MCP-capable clients (Cursor, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex-style tools) build and manage voice agents through Retell APIs. Its documented tools include creating, updating, publishing and listing agents and agent versions, and a probe confirms the official MCP server docs page is live. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working, and evidence of install/auth setup details and the full tool scope beyond agent management.
